newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Usko busy again on take-over rumours.
newsitem.headline: Usko busy again on take-over rumours.

text.p: Shares in South African copper products and conductors firm, Usko Ltd, saw heavy dealings at the start of trade on Tuesday amid continued speculation that the company will be taken over.
By 0840 GMT over 1.2 million Usko shares had traded. The share was up two cents to 44 cents.
"It is up just on the speculation. There is nothing out yet from the company. But the market seldom lies, there is something going on there," a dealer said.
More than five million Usko shares traded on Monday, more than half its average monthly trade of around eight million shares, dealers said.
An Usko spokesman said he could shed no light on the heavy volumes.

Usko shares saw heavy dealings late last year amid similar speculation and following a cautionary issued in November. However, the company put paid to the rumours by announcing in January that unspecified negotiations had been terminated.
